initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new standalone 3D icon for the Greek educational nomenclature game "Χτίσε το όνομα" (Build the Name), sibling to an existing icon consisting of a softly beveled glossy petrol-teal wrench with mint and pale peach molecular spheres. Create a brand-new subject in that same polished, friendly 3D product-render style.
Primary request: a small unfinished section of wall built out of thick rounded rectangular name-component tiles, plus one recognizable mason's trowel actively spreading a small amount of fresh mortar along the top edge.
Composition: compact unified silhouette, square canvas, entire wall and entire trowel visible with comfortable transparent margins; gentle three-quarter front view, not steep isometric; the wall is the main object, trowel diagonally poised just above it with the blade touching the mortar. Two short staggered courses of chunky tile-like bricks, about five blocks total, a visibly unfinished upper course. The front lower course has three readable tile faces bearing the exact Greek components from left to right "μεθ", "άν", "ιο"; these are separate embossed name tiles, not a sentence or a sign. Only these three text labels, no title, no Latin text, no extra writing.
Style and palette: high-quality smooth sculpted 3D illustration, soft bevels, subtle glossy highlights, softly rounded edges, rich deep petrol teal #254c50 and medium teal #3c8080 with pastel mint #dcefe6 and one restrained warm pale-peach accent. Soft satin materials matching the existing teal workshop wrench icon, not flat vector and not photorealistic rough construction masonry. The labels are dark teal, bold and clearly legible. Realistic recognizable trowel with a triangular slightly rounded satin steel blade tinted teal, short curved neck and chunky rounded petrol-teal handle. Mortar is a modest neat cream-colored ridge with a small dollop under the blade.
Lighting: soft studio light from upper left, restrained contact shadows only on the objects, clean highlights that show volume. No ground plane or floor shadow.
Background: true transparent alpha background. No white or colored backdrop, no checkerboard baked in, no badge circle, no border. No person, no hands, no hard hat, no extra tools or molecular model. Keep the design simple and readable as an app icon.
